title: The circle gets smaller as the calling gets higher. 📉🏔️
paragraphs: The circle gets smaller as the calling gets higher. 📉🏔️
"A gospel warrior stands alone not because they want to—but because loyalty fades when the pressure rises."
It hurts, but it’s necessary. The crowd loves the miracles, but they scatter at the crucifixion. Everyone wants to be part of the victory, but few want to be in the trenches.

If you look around and find yourself standing alone, don't be discouraged. You are in good company. Even Paul had to say, "Everyone deserted me." But he followed it with the only truth that matters: "But the Lord stood with me."
Your solitude isn't a sign of failure. It's a sign of focus.
📖 "At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me... But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength." — 2 Timothy 4:16-17
Drop a ✊ if you’re still standing, no matter who left. ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior
